args.address_format.description: Address display format: "hex" or "decimal". When "decimal", the -a flag is enabled.

args.chars_per_line.description: Number of characters per line in hex display (1 to terminal width). When absent or invalid, defaults to full terminal width.

args.output_file.description: Default output file for save operations. If empty, no -o flag is emitted.

args.input_file.description: Input file to open on startup. If empty, no input is opened initially.

args.input_flag.description: Whether to prefix input_file with -i (required only when input_file is not the last argument).
